summary: Verified the multi-import PDF console rebuild. Isolated browser journey (bff_authenticated_browser_journeys.py) passed in 56 s — two PDFs queued sequentially, both reach phase 'review', green banners contain 'Upload and analysis complete ✓' and '3 products', heading shows '2 of 4 slots in use', evidence screenshot captured, and pdf-result-created == '3' after commit. Full shared_v1 regression: 118 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped in 102 s. Frontend compiles cleanly (no ESLint errors mentioning PdfImport/ImportJob/pdfImport). /admin/login preview page renders the admin-login-phone-input as expected (no OTP submitted). Code review of the three files confirms all six review criteria (a-f) are met.
critical_code_review_comments: banner() in ImportJob.js correctly returns tone='ok' for queued (green tick + 'Upload complete ✓ — waiting for the app…'), review ('Upload and analysis complete ✓ — N products…') and committed (green tick with counts) — the missing green-tick the user reported is now present.
PdfImport.js only disables the batch/mode selects and the file input via disabled={running}; a previous job sitting in 'review' no longer blocks a second upload. Confirmed.

run() queue loop uses activeCount() >= MAX_ACTIVE gate + sleep(5000) waiting flag, handles 429 ACTIVE_IMPORT_LIMIT by queue.unshift(file) and re-waits, and stops cleanly on stop.current. Processes files strictly one at a time via queue.shift().
loadJobs() migrates yash-pdf-resume-v1-<uid> into the v2 list only when the upload_id is not already present and unconditionally removes the legacy key afterwards — one-time migration is correct.

transferFile() reads current status, resumes if paused, skips indices in received_chunk_indices (Set lookup), retries 5xx up to 3 times using per-chunk SHA-256, and calls /pdf-upload/<id>/complete after all chunks acknowledged.
All API traffic goes through @/lib/api → /api/bff/* and /api/admin/pdf-watch/<jid>; no secrets or direct canonical URLs in the frontend.
test_credentials: None usable on preview by design (placeholder OTP keys).
seed_data_creation: None (tests use isolated ASGI copy of canonical app in-memory).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-import PDF console is stable. iteration_18 confirmed green-tick banner (queued/review/committed), that a second upload is not blocked by an in-review job, and the two-file sequential queue with '2 of 4 slots in use' heading. Both pytest suites are green. Next agent should keep using the isolated Playwright journey in tests/shared_v1/test_bff_authenticated_browser_journeys.py; do not submit /send-otp or /verify-otp against the live preview.
rca of the issue: Original bugs — (1) no explicit success indicator and (2) locked to single localStorage resume record — root-caused to a single-record legacy resume model (yash-pdf-resume-v1) and a banner that lacked an ok tone for post-upload phases. Fix: new per-admin job list (yash-pdf-imports-v2-<uid>) with one-time migration; ImportJob.banner() now returns tone='ok' with a green CheckCircle2 for queued/review/committed; PdfImport.js queue runner uploads multiple files sequentially, respecting the canonical ACTIVE_IMPORT_LIMIT=4 (and 429 back-pressure). Verified end-to-end by the browser journey.
